context: Request: which Bankruptcy & Restructuring matters produced a confirmed plan of reorganization that the firm drafted. Rubric: 1006-00002 (Crestline Packaging / CPS Holdings), plus a precision criterion. Near-misses the agent ruled out: 1020-00002, 1024-00001, 1044-00003, 1011-00002, 1012-00002.

stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the capped listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for request terms times out with about 154K characters; the agent names four candidates.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Three parallel find | grep searches over file and folder paths for request words; one matter stands out by its file names.

stages.stage: Write the response

stages.stage: Check or revise the response

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All three runs passed with the same procedure: store listing and folder count, a store-wide extraction scan that timed out but surfaced the matter, file-name searches on which only that matter had file names of the requested documents, a listing of a few candidates, in-depth reads of that matter's plan, confirmation order, engagement letter and effectiveness certificate, one or more phrase scans over all matters (rerun in matter-number ranges after timeouts), and reads of the near-misses to rule them out. Every review from the listing stage on flagged the dozens of unopened matters; the agents answered by narrowing or softening the exclusivity wording rather than by opening them, which did not affect the grade.
